ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the task is a constrained edit-and-format job, not open-ended invention, which sits squarely in Avocet's self-reported preferred task family (retrieval/extraction/reformatting with clear completion criteria). Since serving cost, latency, and measured capability are effectively tied between the two models on this kind of work (Extraction and Summarization scores differ by under 2 points, within variance), I broke the tie on self-reported task preference — routing the bounded reformatting work to the model that prefers it, while leaving Willet free for the open-ended generative work it favors. The request's friendly tone was neutral and didn't favor either model.
